provenance.coupling: Block Gauss–Seidel co-simulation: switching timeline → bus energisation (NetworkX) → pump availability (energised and V ≥ 0.90 pu, latching undervoltage trip) → EPANET 2.2 extended-period hydraulics (60 s step, pressure-driven demand) → pump electrical demand P = ρgQH/η (pf 0.85) → pandapower AC Newton–Raphson power flow every frame → pump-bus voltage re-check; repeated until the pump schedule is a fixed point (≤ 4 iterations). Final run: 1 iteration(s), converged.

events.title: Normal operation
events.detail: Demand 3256 kW (incl. 43 kW pumping), Vmin 0.923 pu at B18; 2/2 pumps running, tanks T1 50%, T2 50%; minimum service pressure 36.9 m.

events.title: Fault on Feeder F3 · line B27–B28
SW-06-26 tripped
events.detail: Protection opened SW-06-26: 8 buses (B26, B27, B28, B29, B30, B31, B32, B33) de-energised, 829 kW interrupted; facilities affected: City Hospital, Pumping Station PS-2, District Cooling Plant DC-1.

events.title: City Hospital on backup generation
events.detail: Genset 150 kW carries the essential electrical load; it does not supply water.

events.title: PU-2 stopped (PS-2 duty pump)
events.detail: Supply bus B33 de-energised; zone now depends on tank storage.

events.title: Faulted section isolated
events.detail: Opened SW-27-28; reclosed SW-06-26 — B26, B27 re-energised. Isolated section: —; still de-energised: B28, B29, B30, B31, B32, B33.

events.title: Cascading impact evaluated
events.detail: Without further switching: 6 healthy buses (B28, B29, B30, B31, B32, B33, 706 kW) remain de-energised; PU-2 offline; projected: Tank T2 below 25% at 17:40; projected: City Hospital pressure below 20 m at 18:12 (coupled power flow + extended-period hydraulic projection).

events.title: 80 recovery candidates evaluated
events.detail: Each candidate solved with AC power flow and the extended-period hydraulic model; 21 feasible, 59 rejected (2 loop, 40 undervoltage, 17 thermal).

events.title: Plan C16 Simulation Verified
events.detail: Close SW-25-29 · shed B30. Independent re-solve: 8 hard checks passed; advisories: Voltage advisory (soft).

events.title: B30 shed (District Cooling Plant DC-1)
events.detail: Non-critical load (178 kW, 534 kVAr) left off so the restored area stays within every hard limit.

events.title: PU-2 restarted
events.detail: Supply restored at B33; pumping 43.3 L/s at 33.9 m (19.5 kW).

events.title: 554 kW restored
events.detail: Re-energised B28, B29, B31, B32, B33 via the verified plan; 178 kW shed (B30), net +376 kW.

events.title: End of simulation horizon
events.detail: Served 3540 of 3739 kW (199 kW shed by the plan: B30); 2/2 pumps running; critical-facility pressure 38.2 m; tanks T1 53%, T2 55%.

timeline.label: Service restored
timeline.detail: 79% net restoration at end of horizon (restored ÷ restored + unserved); B30 shed by the plan
